proof_body:
by
  intro A _ e he
  have hco : IsCoprime (Ideal.span {e}) (Ideal.span {1 - e}) :=
    (Ideal.isCoprime_span_singleton_iff e (1 - e)).mpr ⟨1, 1, by ring⟩
  have hinf : Ideal.span {e} ⊓ Ideal.span {1 - e} = (⊥ : Ideal A) := by
    rw [Ideal.inf_eq_mul_of_isCoprime hco, Ideal.span_singleton_mul_span_singleton]
    have : e * (1 - e) = 0 := by rw [mul_sub, mul_one, he, sub_self]
    rw [this]; simp
  exact ⟨(RingEquiv.quotientBot A).symm.trans ((Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hinf.symm).trans (Ideal.quotientInfEquivQuotientProd _ _ hco))⟩
target_source: ∀ (A : Type*) [CommRing A] (e : A), e * e = e → Nonempty (A ≃+* (A ⧸ Ideal.span {e}) × (A ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - e}))
